title: feat(triage): carry the author's trust tier in pull request facts
body:
Actions and checks can condition on the author's trust tier, but no triage fact carried it.

- GitHub tool: `getPr` returns the pull request's author association from the payload it already fetches. No new request.
- Contracts: `RepoPolicy.approvedAuthors`, a lowercased, de-duplicated login list parsed leniently like the rest of the policy and kept by the portal's existing save path. `tierOf(association, author, approvedAuthors)`: OWNER and MEMBER are internal, COLLABORATOR is approved, anything else is approved only when the login is listed, otherwise external. Unknown association values map to external.
- Workflow: `PrFacts.tier` computed in `buildFacts` from the pull request and the policy. Degraded items are external.

Verified: `bun run check`; github-tool, triage-contracts and triage-workflows tests (51), including a tier table with mixed-case logins and an unknown association, a policy round trip, and a facts test that the tier reaches facts.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: feat(github-tool): return the pull request author association
feat(contracts): add approved authors to repo policy and derive trust tiers
feat(triage): carry the author's trust tier in pull request facts

files.patch:
@@ -138,6 +138,7 @@ export async function getPr(gh: GithubFetch, repo: string, number: number) {

+    authorAssociation: p.author_association ?? null,
     sha: p.head?.sha,
     branch: p.head?.ref,
     base: p.base?.ref,

@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ export function toFacts(pr: PRRecord): PrFacts {
     number: pr.id,
     title: pr.title,
     author: pr.author,
+    tier: pr.tier,
     headSha: pr.revision,
     state: pr.state,
     draft: pr.draft,
